goal: Accept valid 65-byte Taproot SIGHASH_ALL signatures when the PSBT sighash type is unset
Prevents false mismatch errors that block downstream signing and finalization with external signers
agreement: Support because SIGHASH_ALL and SIGHASH_DEFAULT commit to the identical BIP-341 digest (Husteem)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes an interoperability bug where valid 65-byte Taproot signatures trigger SIGHASH_MISMATCH
Restores multi-signer and finalization workflows when external signers omit the sighash type field
